input.prompt: The user asks: "how can i use the cursor cli to trigger a code revie[w]". Research current Cursor product documentation for the Cursor CLI and determine the exact command(s) for triggering a code review, including whether it reviews uncommitted changes, a branch/PR, or invokes Bugbot. Return a concise, evidence-based answer with command examples and any key prerequisites or limitations. Do not edit files.

content.text:
From inside your repository, run:

```bash
agent -p --mode=ask \
  "Review all staged and unstaged changes for bugs, regressions, and security issues. Include file and line references."
```

To review your branch against `main`:

```bash
agent -p --mode=ask \
  "Review the current branch against origin/main."
```

Authenticate first with `agent login`. `--mode=ask` keeps the review read-only.

To trigger Bugbot on a GitHub PR:

```bash
gh pr comment 42 --body "cursor review"
```

Bugbot must be enabled for the repository. There is currently no dedicated `agent review` CLI command.

content.text:
On macOS, install Cursor CLI with:

```bash
curl https://cursor.com/install -fsS | bash
```

Then verify and authenticate:

```bash
agent --version
agent login
agent status
```

If `agent` isn’t found, add `~/.local/bin` to your `PATH`.
